Subject: Nexus x Redwood — Q3 co-op: booth + webinar proposal

Marcus —

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Nexus is excited to propose a joint presence at the Q3 Cloud Summit (August 12-13) plus a short follow-up webinar the week after to drive leads to trials. High-level ask from our side:

- Shared 10x10 booth (split staffing & lead-sharing)
- Joint 45-minute webinar on "Cost-conscious LLM serving patterns" w/ 2x presenters (1 from Nexus, 1 from Redwood)
- MDF request: $12k toward booth build + $6k toward webinar promotion

Attached is a short sketch of the booth and a proposed timeline. Can your team confirm whether MDF is possible under Redwood co-op, and who owns booth shipping/invoice? Also — do you have deck templates and legal review turn-times for partner content?

Happy to hop on a quick planning call this week if that's easier.

Best,
Tom Bender
Head of Partnerships
Nexus Analytics

Subject: Re: Nexus x Redwood — Q3 co-op: booth + webinar proposal

Tom —

Appreciate the clear ask and the sketch — this is doable but we need to confirm a few items from Redwood operations and bookings. Quick answers up front:

- MDF: we can approve up to $10k for booth build + $5k for webinar promotion under the standard co-marketing ladder, pending a short MOU and receipts. If Nexus can cover the delta, we can expedite.
- Booth logistics: Redwood covers registration and badges for two Redwood staff; Nexus covers shipping to the venue and local hardware. We can discuss shared booth staffing schedule.
- Legal & deck templates: internal legal turnaround for partner co-branded collateral is ~5 business days once we submit the final deck. I will attach the Redwood partner slide template and an initial timeline.

Can Vanessa and Jonas weigh in on staffing and lead-sharing? Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm MDF split and sign MOU (I can draft).
2) Align on webinar date window (Aug 17-21 suggested).
3) Finalize booth staff schedule and lead capture process (HubSpot shared form).

If that works, I can schedule a 30-min planning call Thursday afternoon.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-8291

Attachment: Q3-CoMarketing-Timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet stub); Redwood_Partner_Slide_Template.pptx (pptx stub)
